# hostinger_vps_virtual_machine (Resource)

Manages an existing VPS virtual machine in the Hostinger account. This resource does not support creation, so it must be imported using the `terraform import` or `terraform query` command.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String)
- `ns1` (String)
- `ns2` (String)

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

- `actions_lock` (String)
- `bandwidth` (Number)
- `cpus` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `data_center_id` (Number)
- `disk` (Number)
- `firewall_group_id` (Number)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `ipv4` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `ipv6` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6))
- `memory` (Number)
- `plan` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `subscription_id` (String)
- `template` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--template))
